title: 第10章 回家第11章 断魂
content_zh:
在青阳城待了大半个月，许星遥后面每日都与林澈一同照料灵兽寒月犀，偶尔去林家藏书阁翻阅典籍，日子过得悠闲自在。
林家的长辈待他极好，尤其是林红药和赵爷爷，时常指点他灵植之术，让他受益匪浅。
午后的阳光暖融融地洒在庭院里。
两只小兽正在草地上嬉戏打闹，银白色的兽皮在阳光下闪闪发亮。
较大的那只正追着一只彩蝶上蹿下跳，较小的则优雅地蹲坐在石凳上，时不时伸出爪子拨弄身旁的野花。
这两个小家伙也该有个正经名字了。
林澈蹲下身，挠了挠自己那只活泼灵兽的下巴。
小兽舒服地眯起眼睛，发出呼噜呼噜的声音。
许星遥看着自己那只在石凳上端坐的小兽，花：我的这只安静，不如就叫‘糖球’吧。
那我这只贪吃，就叫‘银团子’吧。
林澈话刚说完，活泼的小兽突然窜到他肩上，一口叼走了他腰间挂着的玉佩。
林澈手忙脚乱地去追，小兽却灵活地在假山间穿梭，最后得意洋洋地蹲在最高处，玉佩在阳光下闪闪发光。
好你个‘银团子’！
林澈气急败坏地喊道。
许星遥忍俊不禁。
只见银团子得意地晃着脑袋，突然脚下一滑，一声栽进了池塘。
糖球见状，优雅地站起身，慢悠悠地走到池边，伸爪把狼狈的同伴捞了上来。
青阳城的夜色如一幅泼墨山水，皎洁的月光为林府的飞檐翘角镀上一层银辉。
许星遥独立于后花园的九曲回廊，指尖无意识地摩挲着腰间的储物袋。
夜风拂过，带来远处墨梅的清香，却吹不散他眉间的愁绪。

我就知道你还未歇息。
林澈的声音伴随着轻盈的脚步声传来。
他手中提着两坛泥封完好的千年醉，月光在青瓷酒坛上流转，映出内里琥珀色的琼浆。
许星遥转身，月光在他清俊的面容上投下斑驳的树影：明日便要启程回家，心中思绪万千，难以入眠。
林澈拍开泥封，浓郁的酒香顿时在夜色中弥漫开来。
他斟满两盏青玉杯，酒液在月光下泛着诱人的光泽：四年未归，近乡情怯也是常理。
许星遥点头，随即却有些犹豫：“只是还有一事，我想拜托你。
我现在已经收集齐炼器材料，若自己再去寻找炼器师炼制，怕来不及返回宗门。”
林澈拍拍他的肩膀：“这有何难？我林家自有炼器师，你把材料给我，我让他们帮你炼制，待我回宗门时带给你便是。”
许星遥也不矫情，当即取出储物袋，将玄冰铁、沉水玉、冰纹铁、星点石、玉铜精、寒玉髓、冥铜心、霜髓金、寒月犀角等材料尽数交给林澈，又取出五十块下品灵石：“我想炼制一面寒属性的镜子，这些材料若有剩余，便作为和灵石一起作为炼器师的报酬，若不够，待我回宗门后再补给你。”
林澈知道他手头不宽裕，一把推回灵石，笑道：“你跟我还谈这个？放心，我定让炼器师给你炼制一面上好的寒属性宝镜！”
许星遥心头一热，仰头饮尽杯中酒。
酒液入喉，先是烈火般的灼热，继而化作冰川般的清冽，最后在丹田处泛起融融暖意。
离开青阳城的官道上，许星遥没有选择凌空，而是信步而行，糖球跟在他脚边。
微风拂过麦田，掀起层层波浪，空气中弥漫着泥土与草木的清香。
其实在离开青阳城之前，许星遥倒是买了一只灵兽袋。
只是他不想糖球憋闷在那狭小的空间里，便放他出来跟着自己。
行至一处山谷时，许星遥忽然驻足。
content_en:
After staying in Qingyang City for more than half a month, Xu Xingyao and Lin Che took care of the spiritual beast Han Yuexi every day. He occasionally went to the Lin family library to read classics, and lived a leisurely life.
The elders of the Lin family treated him very well, especially Lin Hongyao and Grandpa Zhao, who often taught him the art of spiritual planting, which benefited him a lot.
The afternoon sun shines warmly on the courtyard.
Two little beasts were playing and playing on the grass, their silver-white hides shining in the sun.
The larger one is jumping up and down chasing a colorful butterfly, while the smaller one is squatting gracefully on the stone bench, stretching out its paws to play with the wild flowers beside it from time to time.
It’s time for these two little guys to have serious names.
Lin Che knelt down and scratched the chin of her lively spirit beast.
The little beast narrowed his eyes comfortably and purred.
Xu Xingyao looked at his little beast sitting upright on the stone bench, Hua: My little one is quiet, why not call it 'Tang Ball'.
Then let’s call this glutton of mine ‘Silver Dumpling’.
As soon as Lin Che finished speaking, the lively little beast suddenly rushed to his shoulder and took away the jade pendant hanging from his waist.
Lin Che hurriedly chased after him, but the little beast nimbly shuttled between the rockeries, and finally squatted on the highest point triumphantly, with the jade pendant sparkling in the sun.
What a ‘silver dumpling’!
Lin Che shouted angrily.
Xu Xingyao couldn't help laughing.
I saw Yin Tuanzi shaking his head proudly, suddenly his feet slipped and he fell into the pond with a sound.
Upon seeing this, Tang Qiu stood up gracefully, walked slowly to the edge of the pool, stretched out his claws to fish out his embarrassed companion.
The night in Qingyang City is like a splash-ink landscape, and the bright moonlight coats the cornices of the Lin Mansion with a layer of silver.
Xu Xingyao stood alone in the nine-curved corridor in the back garden, his fingertips unconsciously rubbing the storage bag on his waist.
The night wind blew by, bringing with it the fragrance of plum blossoms in the distance, but it could not dissipate the sadness between his brows.
I knew you hadn't rested yet.
Lin Che's voice came along with the sound of light footsteps.
He held two jars of thousand-year-old wine sealed with clay in his hands. The moonlight circulated on the celadon wine jars, reflecting the amber nectar inside.
Xu Xingyao turned around, and the moonlight cast mottled tree shadows on his handsome face: He will set off to go home tomorrow, and he has so many thoughts in his heart that he can't sleep.
Lin Che patted open the mud seal, and the rich aroma of wine immediately filled the night.
He filled two sapphire cups, and the wine glowed with an alluring luster under the moonlight: It had been four years since he returned home, and it was normal to be timid about being close to home.
Xu Xingyao nodded, but then hesitated: "There is just one more thing I want to ask of you.
I have now collected all the materials for refining the weapon. If I go to find a refining master to refine it, I'm afraid I won't be able to return to the sect in time. "
Lin Che patted him on the shoulder: "What's so difficult about this? My Lin family has its own weapon refiners. Give me the materials and I'll ask them to help you refine it. I'll bring it to you when I return to the sect."
Xu Xingyao did not show any pretense, and immediately took out the storage bag and handed all the materials such as black ice iron, sunken water jade, ice pattern iron, star point stone, jade copper essence, cold chalcedony, dark copper heart, frost marrow gold, cold moon rhinoceros horn and other materials to Lin Che. He also took out fifty low-grade spiritual stones: "I want to refine a mirror with cold attributes. If there are any leftover materials, I will use them as a reward for being a refiner together with the spiritual stones. If there are not enough, I will replenish them for you after I return to the sect."
Lin Che knew that he didn't have much money, so she pushed the spirit stone back and said with a smile: "Are you still talking to me about this? Don't worry, I will definitely let the weapon refiner refine a good cold attribute mirror for you!"
Xu Xingyao's heart felt hot, and he raised his head and drank the entire glass of wine.
When the wine enters the throat, it is first as hot as fire, then as cold as ice, and finally creates a melting warmth in the Dantian.
On the official road leaving Qingyang City, Xu Xingyao did not choose to volley, but walked leisurely, with Tang Qiu following at his feet.
The breeze blew through the wheat fields, setting off layers of waves, and the air was filled with the fragrance of soil and vegetation.
In fact, before leaving Qingyang City, Xu Xingyao bought a spiritBeast bag.
But he didn't want Tang Qiu to be suffocated in that small space, so he let him out and follow him.
When they reached a valley, Xu Xingyao suddenly stopped.
